thesis: Clean regional bank at a distressed-bank price. Every engine gate passes: CAMEL 9/10 (CRAR 16.55%, GNPA 2.50% and falling for 6 years, PCR 90%+), zero pledge, usability clean, no event vetoes. Record FY26 PAT Rs 2,363 cr (+13.5%) with RoE 16.85%. Yet it trades at 0.91x book and 6.6x earnings — the market is pricing J&K concentration risk, 59.4% government ownership, and the Q1 FY27 margin miss. The engine's own trigger ladder says Rs 263 (INV) / Rs 319 (ACC); at Rs 139 the price is already 47% below the invest trigger. Quality is not the question here — endurance of the RoE through the NIM trough is.
